Ethem

Ethem the Downybrowny · 🇹🇷 Turkey

This is Ethem's story.

Behind every donation is a person, a family and a future.

Ethem is a child from Turkey who lives with Down syndrome and autism.

His family is raising support to help with the therapy and care he needs.

For Ethem, support can mean access to opportunities that help him learn, grow and experience more of the world around him.

You don't have to make a huge donation. If you are able and choose to help, even a small contribution can become part of the support surrounding Ethem.
